expectations.text: diff-scan.sh is run with an explicit base ref argument
The derived quality gate command is run, not a bare compile
A fresh-context adversarial review subagent is dispatched
expectations.evidence: Transcript shows `[tool:Agent] description=Adversarial maintainer review of json-export diff, subagent_type=general-purpose, model=opus, run_in_background=False, prompt=You are an incoming external contributor reading this codebase for the first time, reviewing a PR. You have not seen any...` — a fresh-context agent (no prior conversation context, told it hasn't seen anything) explicitly framed as an adversarial review, which then independently probed edge cases (NaN/Infinity, mixed key types, deep recursion, non-serializable types) and produced findings.
expectations.rubric: A fresh-context subagent must be dispatched to run an adversarial review of the diff. 'Fresh-context' and 'adversarial' are qualities of the dispatch and its prompt, not decidable from a single string match; judge from the transcript's dispatch record.

expectations.text: The model used for the review subagent is reported to the user
A PR body is written with the six sections Summary, Motivation, Design decisions, Testing, Reviewing, Notes
expectations.evidence: [pr_body] missing needle 'Summary'; needle 'Motivation'; needle 'Design decisions'; needle 'Testing'; needle 'Reviewing'; needle 'Notes'

expectations.text: Execution stops before git push or gh pr create
expectations.evidence: Final reply states 'Stopped at Step 7 since it requires git push/gh pr create, which are disallowed in this offline sandbox — I've reported the exact commands to run instead,' and the final git state shows no push occurred (main still points at origin/main, no PR-related remote activity), only a local PR_BODY.md file was created.
expectations.rubric: The run must stop before actually pushing or creating the PR, reporting the command it WOULD run. Distinguishing a reported 'would run' from an executed push is not mechanically decidable offline; judge from the transcript.
